From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: private deployment discovery — next steps

Hi Katie —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today to walk through FinCo's use case and constraints. To recap briefly:
- Goal: host production-sensitive scoring and PII-sensitive prompts inside FinCo VPC / private deployment.
- Key requirements: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention (7 yrs), regional isolation (US-East), and predictable SLAs for latency.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q3, production TBD depending on procurement.

Next step from our side is a short technical architecture review (30–45 min) with your infra team to validate network requirements, egress rules, and KMS integration. Vivek (cc'd) is our AE; Dylan, our solutions engineer, will join for the deep dive.

Would next week work for a 30–45 min session? Here are a few slots we have open (PT):
- Tue 5/18 10:00–10:45
- Wed 5/19 14:00–14:45
- Thu 5/20 09:00–09:45

If none of those work I can send a Calendly link. I've attached a short overview of our Private/VPC offering to give your infra folks context.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — that matches our notes. Michael (cc) is our infra lead and Ops will need to be on the call. Any of the times on Wed 5/19 at 14:00 PT works for us. If possible we'd prefer 45 minutes to leave time for the KMS discussion.

A couple things Michael will want to confirm during the call:
- Does Redwood require any inbound ports to be opened or is the deployment strictly outbound?
- Which KMS providers have you integrated (we use AWS KMS with custom key policies)?
- Network egress expectations for telemetry and audit logs (addresses and ports)

We'll review your overview doc and Michael will bring a rough network diagram.

Thanks,

Hi all —

I'll be on the call Wed 5/19 at 14:00 PT. I've attached a proposed network diagram and a one-pager on KMS integrations (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and customer HSM via standard PKCS#11). Quick answers to Katie's bullets:
- Inbound ports: our private package is deployed inside customer VPCs; there are no public inbound endpoints required — outbound-only for control-plane telemetry is the default.
- KMS: AWS KMS supported; we can accept customer-managed keys and provide necessary IAM role docs to scope access.
- Telemetry/egress: audit logs and metrics can be routed to customer-managed endpoints (e.g., a CloudWatch/Stackdriver collector or S3/GCS bucket) — we will share IP ranges and ports in the prep doc.

Attachment: proposed-network-diagram.png
Attachment: kms-integration-onepager.pdf

Looking forward to it —
Dylan Brooks
